      background: #f5a623; color: #fff;

      color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-style: italic;

      position: fixed; bottom: 1.5rem; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(100px);
      background: #1d2125; color: #fff; padding: 0.7rem 1.5rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius); font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
      opacity: 0; transition: all 0.3s ease; z-index: 1000;
    }
    .toast.show { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
    .toast.error { background: #eb5a46; }
    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      .toast { background: #3d464f; }
